detail.title: Operational Criteria for Objective Physical Records
detail.summary: Objective physical records emerge when an environment redundantly encodes and broadcasts pointer states of a quantum system, providing multiple observers access to consistent information while constraining accessibility via noisy-threshold functions.
detail.reason: Synthesizing collected evidence on quantum Darwinism and environmental encoding to establish operational criteria for objective records.

detail.title: Operational Criteria for Publicly Reliable Physical Records
detail.question: What are the necessary operational conditions for a quantum state to qualify as a stable, publicly accessible objective record?
detail.reason: Maintaining active investigation into the operational criteria for objective states and their environmental encoding.
